description: Name the people who may approve a wiki page, and tell each of them: they get a notification that opens the page. 'who' is usernames or e-mails as 'a,b' — each must be able to read the page. Somebody already named is asked again, about the edition the page is at now. With release: true the people in 'who' are taken OFF the list instead; what they already approved stays approved. The project's lead, the company's owner or an admin only.

note.description: A line for the people asked — what changed, by when.

release.description: true to take these people off the page's list instead of asking them.

who.description: Usernames or e-mails, as 'a,b'. Take them from list_users.

name: ask_wiki_page_approval
